crossRefs.note: Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroys the understanding.
crossRefs.keyword: is mad. or, playeth the madman

people.name: Achish
people.line: Philistine king of Gath, gave refuge to David

translations.web: Then Achish said to his servants, “Look, you see the man is insane. Why then have you brought him to me?
translations.bsb: Then Achish said to his servants, “Look, you can see that the man is insane! Why have you brought him to me?
translations.kjv: Then said Achish unto his servants, Lo, ye see the man is mad: wherefore then have ye brought him to me?
translations.asv: Then said Achish unto his servants, Lo, ye see the man is mad; wherefore then have ye brought him to me?
